reason: Right vertical, wrong moment: Chefman (113 employees, $59.1M revenue, Mahwah NJ) is a bullseye ICP on paper - its CHEF iQ brand is an ecosystem of digitally connected kitchen appliances with a React Native BLE companion app, and David just spent 2025 running mobile for SharkClean at direct peer SharkNinja - but no live posting confesses the pain he fixes. The full live Greenhouse board (10 roles, verified via Exa 2026-07-23) contains exactly one Software Engineering job: Tech Lead for SAYDAR, their supply-chain SaaS, whose MUST-HAVE stack is Angular/NGRX/C#/.NET/SignalR, fully onsite five days a week; its lone connected-device phrase ('supporting increasing traffic, connected device ecosystems, and future platform growth') sits inside a backend/cloud-scaling bullet, not a mobile-app bullet. The other two matched jobs are a hardware/plastics NPI Technical Project Manager (SolidWorks/CREO, retailer timelines) and a Procurement Manager - neither redescribes a companion app becoming the bottleneck. The only mobile role Chefman ever posted, Senior React Native Developer for the CHEF iQ app, dates to 2022-05-17 and is absent from the live board, and the app shows no distress signal (4.8 stars across 15.6K App Store ratings, actively maintained by RJ Brands, LLC). No quotable line, so no keep.
